name: Black Ops
author: brightwalker25
description: One switch for privacy protections in stock Omarchy, with a watchdog that shows when one has slipped. It sends nothing anywhere

barWidget.description: A scope in the bar that switches a few privacy settings in stock Omarchy on or off together, and turns amber when an update undoes one

schema.label: Check every (minutes)
schema.description: How often the watchdog checks that every protection is still in place. It runs with the panel closed, reads only local files, and touches no network.

schema.label: Notify when a protection slips
schema.description: Send one desktop notification when a protection stops holding, and no more until it has been put back. The notification names the protection and nothing else.
